how to access opbilling service?

To access the OP billing service, you need to navigate to the OP service billing module, which serves as a single billing point for all outpatient services provided by the hospital. Most billing activities are performed through the 'Service Billing Advanced' screen. You can access this by following the path: **OP Billing/Service Billing Advanced**. ![Service Billing Advanced](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png)

how to generate  radiology invoice

To generate a radiology invoice, follow these steps:

1. **Select the Service**: Choose "radiology" from the service list for billing.
2. **Add the Service**: Enter the item code or name for the radiology service and select it from the list. Then, click on the 'Add' button to include it in the invoice.
3. **Finalize the Invoice**: Once all necessary services are added, click the ‘Save’ button. A pop-up will appear displaying the payable amount for the invoice.

This process will allow you to generate a radiology invoice effectively.

![Radiology Invoice Process](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png)

i mean invoice for packages

The process for invoicing packages in the OP Billing system involves enabling package utilization alerts based on configuration settings. If the parameter for package utilization alert is set to 'Y', the package utilization form will automatically load when billing a package. If set to 'N', this form will not load automatically. To create an invoice for a package, the user must enter the item code or name for the package in the billing system, select it from the list, and then click the 'Add' button to include it in the invoice.
